Today’s read

The India Cements Limited rose 12.0% on 222 times its usual volume. Its exchange filing that session was about guidance or investor update, “Link of Recording”.

Nothing in the news or in exchange filings explains the volume in Mac Charles India Limited (440x), DCM Shriram Industries Limited (266x), Lagnam Spintex Limited (202x). That usually points to a sector story rather than a company one.

21 stocks sit at 52-week lows against 0 at highs. New lows outnumbering new highs this clearly is usually a late signal, not an early one.

What happened
Breaking
Gold Swings as Traders Assess Fed Rate Path Amid Mideast Worries
Gold held near record highs around $2,650 per ounce as Middle East tensions countered reduced expectations of aggressive Federal Reserve rate cuts. Higher landed gold costs elevate working capital requirements for jewelers like Titan and Kalyan Jewellers, while supporting collateral values and asset quality for gold loan financiers Muthoot Finance and Manappuram Finance. Domestic retail volume data during the upcoming festive season will show whether price-sensitive consumers pull back.
Mint Markets · +1 other
RBI flags widening inflation risks, puts rate cuts on ice
The Reserve Bank of India raised the benchmark repo rate by 25 basis points, citing broad-based price pressures exceeding four percent across multiple commodity baskets. The rate hike delays monetary easing expectations, raising borrowing costs for real estate developers and auto buyers while squeezing net interest margins for retail lenders facing sticky deposit costs. The upcoming monthly CPI print will confirm whether this hike remains an isolated adjustment.
ET Markets · +2 others
Jio Platforms' IPO-linked inflows boost rupee; elevated oil prices spur caution
Anticipated foreign capital inflows tied to Jio Platforms' planned initial public offering supported the rupee, offsetting imported inflation pressures from Brent crude hovering above $75 per barrel. A stronger domestic currency cushions import costs for refiners and chemical makers, though parent Reliance Industries remains the direct beneficiary as market-implied valuations for its telecom unit crystallize ahead of the formal filing.
Reuters Business · +2 others
Your themes
NaBFID gets Finance Ministry, RBI nod for national infrastructure project repository
The Reserve Bank of India and Finance Ministry approved NaBFID’s platform to centralize credit, execution, and regulatory data on domestic infrastructure projects. Standardized project visibility reduces information asymmetry for lenders like State Bank of India, REC, and PFC, lowering underwriting risk and provisioning requirements on large-ticket consortium loans. Faster financial closure cycles will directly improve revenue visibility for primary EPC contractors such as Larsen and Toubro.
InfrastructureET Economy
Zerodha launches US stock investing: How to invest in Tesla, Amazon, SpaceX, Meta, Micron, Nvidia and AMD — explained
Zerodha launched beta trading in US equities and exchange-traded funds, enabling fractional delivery investments under the Reserve Bank of India’s Liberalised Remittance Scheme. While it diversifies fee income for unlisted Zerodha, the move increases competitive pressure on listed retail brokerages like Angel One to offer cross-border access, while marginally siphoning domestic retail flow away from small-cap Indian equities.
AI & data centresMint Markets
Sahaj Solar to set up BESS facility in Dakor - BigInfo.in
Sahaj Solar announced a new Battery Energy Storage System manufacturing facility in Dakor, Gujarat, expanding its renewable equipment portfolio. Local BESS manufacturing improves gross margins for solar EPC contractors by reducing battery module import dependencies and freight costs. Monthly order execution data from renewable EPC companies will confirm whether domestic storage integration accelerates gross margin expansion.
Green energy & solarData centres and AI capex
Capital markets
Import window for duty-free raw sugar extended till Dec 31
India extended the import deadline for 10 lakh tonnes of duty-free raw sugar to December 31 after mills processed only 3 lakh tonnes. The lower import volume keeps domestic sugar prices firm, benefiting integrated sugar mills like Balrampur Chini and Triveni Engineering through higher realization prices and improved operating margins. Port import arrivals over the next month will confirm if international price spreads allow profitable refining.
ET Economy
Brookings paper offers broad plan to shrink Fed balance sheet
A Brookings Institution paper outlined mechanisms for the US Federal Reserve to accelerate its balance sheet reduction without disrupting money markets. Faster balance sheet contraction tightens global dollar liquidity, putting upward pressure on US Treasury yields and weakening the Indian rupee. Weekly NSDL data on Foreign Portfolio Investor flows will confirm if global liquidity tightening triggers equity sell-offs in India.
Reuters Business · +1 other
Rethinking Data Centres: Exploring co-location with PSPs, offshore wind and floating solar - Renewable Watch
Renewable developers are evaluating co-locating data centres with pumped storage and floating solar plants to guarantee uninterrupted clean power. Direct power sourcing lowers operational costs for data centre operators and accelerates execution timelines by bypassing grid interconnect delays. Power purchase agreements signed by power generation companies over the next quarter will confirm whether co-located infrastructure drives power sector capital expenditure.
Data centres and AI capex
Macro and economy
ACME Solar vs NTPC Green: Which Renewable Energy Stock Has a Stronger Growth Outlook Through FY29? - Trade Brains
NTPC Green leverages PSU parentage to secure low-cost debt for its 26 gigawatt pipeline, whereas ACME Solar relies on high-yield financing to expand its 6.4 gigawatt portfolio. Balance sheet strength dictates renewable capex, directly impacting gross margins under fixed-tariff power purchase agreements. The key metric to watch is quarterly commissioned capacity versus targets to gauge execution slippage.
Order wins and capex
Inflation remains top of mind, MPC minutes show
The monetary policy committee raised the repo rate by 25 basis points as rising core inflation signals sticky price pressures. Higher benchmark rates increase marginal cost of funds for banks and elevate interest expenses across capital-intensive sectors like automotive and real estate. Monthly consumer price index prints above five percent will confirm whether further monetary tightening remains necessary.
ET Economy · +1 other
Why RBI is draining excess liquidity but also injecting funds
The Reserve Bank of India actively neutralised surplus banking liquidity from FCNR dollar inflows through reverse repo auctions and cash reserve ratio tweaks. By absorbing structural excess while injecting fine-tuning funds, the central bank keeps money market rates anchored near the policy repo rate. This maintains credit transmission across commercial banks without squeezing short-term lending margins or treasury yields.
ET Markets
Indian banks open cheque books for ₹10,000 crore-plus in M&A funding after RBI rule change
Commercial banks led by State Bank of India are now funding up to 75 percent of corporate M&A deal values following relaxed central bank financing norms. This unlocks an estimated two lakh crore rupee acquisition-financing pipeline, expanding corporate loan books and fee income for major lenders. Quarterly corporate loan growth data will show if banks convert this deal activity into sustained credit expansion.
ET Markets
Companies and earnings
Persistent Systems launches Rs 4,265-cr QIP; floor price set at Rs 5,550/share
Persistent Systems launched a 4,265 crore rupee qualified institutional placement with a floor price of 5,550 rupees per share. The fresh capital equity dilution will temporarily lower return on equity but equips the mid-cap IT services firm with dry powder for inorganic acquisitions in North America. Final subscription pricing will indicate institutional demand for high-valuation Indian software exporters.
ET Markets · +1 other
COMMENTARY: Five AI quirks and conundrums to watch this earnings season
Global technology companies face rising capital expenditure and uncertain return metrics on artificial intelligence deployments this earnings season. Big Tech spending directly influences offshore engineering and digital transformation contract flows for Indian IT services exporters like TCS and Infosys. Big Tech quarterly guidance on software services spending will clarify whether domestic IT revenue growth accelerates this year.
Reuters Business
Germany's SAP hits €10 billion quarterly revenue milestone, lifts 2026 view
SAP reported quarterly revenue above €10 billion and raised its 2026 operating profit outlook on resilient cloud backlog growth. For Indian tier-one IT services firms, enterprise cloud migration remains a core driver of discretionary deal flow. Sustained demand for S/4HANA migrations benefits implementation partners including Infosys, Wipro, and LTIMindtree, easing recent concerns over client cuts to European software budgets.
Reuters Business
Aditya Birla AMC Q2 net profit dips 8.4% to Rs 221 crore
Aditya Birla Sun Life AMC reported an 8.4% drop in second-quarter net profit to ₹221 crore, as total expenses jumped 21% despite revenue growing 5% to ₹484 crore. The cost inflation highlights ongoing yield compression and customer acquisition costs across the asset management sector. The earnings drag widens the operational margin gap between mid-sized asset managers and larger peers like HDFC AMC.
ET Markets
Geopolitics
China Stock Rescue May Need More State Buying to Work, Bloomberg Intelligence Says
China state-backed equity buying has failed to reverse local market declines, requiring aggressive fiscal stimulus to restore investor confidence. For Indian equities, sluggish Chinese financial markets reduce the risk of emerging market fund reallocations away from domestic shares. Weak Chinese factory activity also limits upside pressure on global industrial metal prices, protecting input margins for Indian auto and capital goods manufacturers.
Mint Markets
Critical tech list under review to push self-reliance
NITI Aayog is compiling a prioritized list of critical technologies spanning defence, 6G telecom gear, and electric mobility to drive domestic manufacturing. Formal classification typically precedes dedicated production-linked incentives and preferential public procurement. Listed defence contractors such as Bharat Electronics and electronics manufacturing service providers stand to gain long-term order visibility as government policies accelerate import substitution.
ET Economy
India rate panel flags more hikes but wary of aggressive cycle, minutes show
Reserve Bank of India monetary policy minutes show members favoring incremental rate hikes while cautioning against aggressive monetary tightening. A measured hiking path limits immediate downside risks to retail loan growth across banks. However, elevated terminal interest rates will sustain pressure on borrowing costs for non-banking financial companies and delay debt-refinancing benefits for capital-intensive infrastructure firms.
